origin.origins.human.description:
§l§nOverview§r:
Masiirka bini'aadamku wuu ka fur furan yahay inta badan - ku dadaalida wax faa'iido iyo dib u dhac toona.
origin.medievalorigins.alfiq.name: Alfiq
origin.medievalorigins.alfiq.description:
§l§nOverview§r:
§o§2+ Gunno Aan Hubaysnayn§r
§o§2+ Dhaqdhaqaaq Gaar ah§r
§o§6• Carnivore§r
§o§c- Difaaca§r
§lAlfiq§r waa noocyo khiyaano leh oo ka mid ah xayawaannada anthropomorphic oo leh ciddi fiiqan iyo firfircooni aad u fiican.Wadooyinkoodu inta badan waxay keenaan ciid diiran.
origin.medievalorigins.arachnae.name: Arachnae
origin.medievalorigins.arachnae.descript:
§l§nOverview§r:
§o§2+ Sun, Xakamaynta dadka
+ Koritaanka gidaarka§r
§o§6• Carnivore§r
§o§c- Gaajada, Armor§r
Isku darka caarada iyo bini'aadamka oo aad u qurux badan, oo leh caaro sun leh iyo cago fiiqan oo haddana awood u leh inay si qumman u socdaan oo ay hub qaataan.
origin.medievalorigins.banshee.name: Banshee
origin.medievalorigins.banshee.descripti:
§l§nOverview§r:
§o§2+ Duulimaadka, Taageerada, Marxaladda§r
§o§6• Dhintay
§o§c- Difaaca§r
§o§c- Isbeddel aad u daran, marka hore akhri!§r
§lBanshees§r waa ruux murugaysan oo oohintoodu waxay dumin kartaa muraayadda oo dadka ku waali karta.Khuraafaad ahaan, joogitaankooda ayaa inta badan loo arkaa calaamad dhimasho.
origin.medievalorigins.incubus.name: Incubus
origin.medievalorigins.incubus.descripti:
§l§nOverview§r:
§o§2+ gunooyinka Nether
§o§6• Dab ku salaysan
§o§c- uu waxyeeleeyay Water§r
§o§c- daciifka ah
§lIncubi§r waa addoommo xunxun oo xoog madow ah.Iyagu dhulkooda ayay ku xoog badan yihiin, laakiin taas beddelkeeda ayay naftoodii ka tageen, oo waxay ku daciifeen ilo saafi ah.
origin.medievalorigins.dwarf.name: Ciirsi
origin.medievalorigins.dwarf.description:
§l§nOverview§r:
§o§2+ Macdanta, Caving§r
§o§6• Gaaban: 102cm.3'7"§r
§o§c- Qorraxda xasaasiga ah
Ma dabaalan karo§r
§lDwarves§r waa wax la taaban karo, faa'iido badan, iyo kibir badan.Waxay ku fiican yihiin macdanta iyo ku noolaanshaha dhulka hoostiisa, laakiin waxay la halgamaan iftiinka maalinta.Dhagax iyo dhagax walaal.
origin.medievalorigins.wood_elf.name: Qoryo elf
origin.medievalorigins.wood_elf.descript:
§l§nOverview§r:
§o§2+ gunooyin kala duwan, Speed§r
§o§6• Qarsoon, Khudaareed§r
§o§c- Difaaca§r
§lWood Elves§r waa qoom caqli badan, oo cimri dheer, kaas oo la nool dhulka.Way dheereeyaan seef iyo qaanso, Oo waxay ka adkaadaan cadaawayaashooda inta ay geedaha ku dhex jiraan.
origin.medievalorigins.high_elf.name: Sare Elf
origin.medievalorigins.high_elf.descript:
§l§nOverview§r:
§o§2+ Sixirka, Awoodaha Gaarka ah§r
§o§c- Burbur Jireed
- Difaaca§r
§lHigh Elves§r waa dad aad u kibir badan, in kastoo aan la dafiri karin karti;koorsada sixirka aasaasiga ah si xoog leh iyada oo loo marayo dhiiggooda, in kasta oo ay ka daciifsan yihiin hub.
origin.medievalorigins.fae.name: Fayo
origin.medievalorigins.fae.description:
§l§nOverview§r:
§o§2+ Hovering, Magic§r
§o§6• Gaaban: 122cm.4'0"§r
§o§c- Waxaa Jecel Mobs§r
§lFae§r waa xayawaan sixir ah oo kaymo ah oo xarrago leh, oo lagu dhex daray sixirka dabiiciga ah oo si qoto dheer ugu xiran kaymaha ay ka soo jeedaan.
origin.medievalorigins.goblin.name: Goblin
origin.medievalorigins.goblin.descriptio:
§l§nOverview§r:
§o§2+ Lacagaha Gear Dahab ah§r
§o§2+ Nasiib, Speed§r
§o§6• Yar: 92cm.3'3"§r
§o§c- Caafimaadka, Difaaca§r
§lGoblins§r waxay ku waalan yihiin dahabka iyo hantida waxayna u muuqdaan inay helaan wax yar oo booli ah meel kasta oo ay eegaan, laakiin cabbirkooda yar ayaa ka dhiga inay u nuglaadaan dagaalka.
origin.medievalorigins.gorgon.name: Gorgon
origin.medievalorigins.gorgon.descriptio:
§l§nOverview§r:
§o§2+ Burburka Sunta, Difaaca §r
§o§2+ Xakamaynta Crowd§r
§o§c- Hydrophobe
- daciifnimo gaar ah§r
§lGorgons§r waa makhluuqaad la habaaray oo beri biniaadmi ahaan jiray, timo ka samaysan abeesooyin qallafsan, oo fiisooyin xunxun oo la sheegay inay dhibsadaan kuwa markhaatiga u ah.
origin.medievalorigins.moon_elf.name: Dayax Elf
origin.medievalorigins.moon_elf.descript:
§l§nOverview§r:
§o§2+ Burbur Toorey
+ Dextrous§r
§o§6• Qarsoon, Ma Seexan§r
§o§c- Difaaca§r
Dahsoon, makhluuqaad aan dunidan ahayn.Moon elves looma magacaabin dalkooda hooyo, laakiin waxa kaliya ee dhibanayaashu ay arki karaan ka hor inta aysan dhamaanin.
origin.medievalorigins.ogre.name: Og
origin.medievalorigins.ogre.description:
§l§nOverview§r:
§o§2+ Gunnooyinka Faas, Difaaca §r
§o§6• Weyn: 268cm.9'5"§r
§o§c- Gaajada, Xawaaraha §r
§lOgres§r waa nooc weyn, xanaaq badan, iyo nacasnimo ah Orc.Cabbirkooda alwaaxdooda iyo garaadkooda xaddidan waxaa lagu sameeyay xooggooda cayriin.
origin.medievalorigins.pixie.name: Pixie
origin.medievalorigins.pixie.description:
§l§nOverview§r:
§o§2+ Duulimaadka Gaarka ah, Odd§r
§o§6• Yar: 22cm.9" §r
§o§c- Difaaca, Sumcadda §r
Inta badan waxaa loo arkaa hargabka nasiib wanaag, laakiin sidoo kale khiyaano, wakiilada xumaanta aan la aamini karin.Pixies waa wax aad iyo aad u yar.
origin.medievalorigins.plague_victim.des:
§l§nOverview§r:
§o§2+ Qulqulaya §r
§o§6• Playstyle gaar ah §r
§o§6• Dhintay §r
§o§c- Difaaca, Sumcadda
§o§c- adag§r
Makhluuqa badhkii dhintay oo cudurku ku dhacay oo aan hadda loogu yeedhi karin bini'aadam, habaaran oo ku xayiran silica weligeed ah taasoo ka dhalatay cudur sixir la yaab leh.
origin.medievalorigins.revenant.name: Aarsasho
origin.medievalorigins.revenant.descript:
§l§nOverview§r:
§o§2+ U Yeedhay §r
§o§2+ Illager saaxiibtinimo leh
§o§6• Dhintay, Kakan §r
§o§c- Sumcad
- Isdhexgalka nolosha §r
§lRevenants§r waa nafo nasiib darro ah oo u dhintay dhimasho aad u xun oo xanuun badan, laakiin si aan la macnayn karin ugu soo noolaaday.Taasina waxay keentay inay ku mashquulaan inay nolosha iyo dhimashada makhluuqa kale ku dhaqmaan.
origin.medievalorigins.siren.name: Seeri
origin.medievalorigins.siren.description:
§l§nOverview§r:
§o§2+ Biyo Ku-salaysan, Utility §r
§o§6• Tabar yar Land§r
§o§c- U nugul Fire§r
§lSirens§r waxaa la sheegay inuu yahay nooc ka mid ah Merfolk.Waxay leeyihiin aura soo jiidasho leh oo quruxdooda aan la adkeyn karin ayaa la sheegay inay tahay burburka badmaaxiinta nacasyada badan.
origin.medievalorigins.yeti.name: Yeti
origin.medievalorigins.yeti.description:
§l§nOverview§r:
§o§2+ Baraf-ku-salaysan, Tanky§r
§o§6• Weyn: 203cm.6'8"§r
§o§c- Xasaasiyadda Kulaylka§r
Xayawaanka dhogorta leh ee ka soo baxa qoryo dhaxan leh, maamulka Yeti ee barafku wuxuu u ogolaanayaa inay qaboojiyaan cadawga, laakiin waxay si gaar ah ugu nugul yihiin weerarrada dabka ah.
origin.medievalorigins.valkyrie.name: Valkyrie
origin.medievalorigins.valkyrie.descript:
§l§nOverview§r:
§o§2+ Bogsiinta§r
§o§6• baalasha baalasha leh§r
§o§c- daciif ah oo aan la dhiman§r
§lValkyrie§r waa dagaalyahano aan cabsi lahayn oo baalashooda leh, kuwaas oo ka tashanaya aayaha kuwa dagaalka ku jira;waxaa la sheegay in ay meydadka u qaadeen Odin ee Valhalla
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.clawed.name: Ciddiye
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.clawed.descr: Alfiq waxay leeyihiin cidiyihii soo laaban kara oo fiiqan;waxay waxyeelo dheeraad ah ku gaystaan baabacooyin madhan, waxayna kor u fuuli karaan oo ay ku dhegi karaan sagxadaha dhaadheer (Waa la rogi karaa)
Qorrax-dhaca iyo qorrax-soo-baxa u dhow, Alfiq wuu dhaqaaqi doonaa oo si degdeg ah ayuu u weerari doonaa.Waqtiyada kale, way caajisaan oo xoogaa gaabis ah.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.on_your_feet: Haddii, marka aad soo degayso, aad si toos ah hoos u eegayso, waxba ha ka yeelin dayrta.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.pickpocket.d: Midig ku dhufo dhabarka qof tuulo ah adiga oo ku lumaya calaacaha madhan si aad fursad ugu hesho qaar ka mid ah emeralds.Ama la qabto.Wararka xanta ah ayaa sheegaya in laga yaabo inaad ka xaddo ciyaartoyda kale.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.pounce.name: Ku dhufo
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.pounce.descr: Ka dib markii uu si kooban u foorarsado isaga oo aan u dhaqaaqin si uu kor ugu qaado, Alfiq waxa uu hore u boodboodi karaa masaafo aad u weyn.Ku dhufashada cadawga inta lagu jiro boodboodka waxay wax ka qabataa dhaawaca gunnada.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.poor_grip.de: Alfiq waxay yaraysay xawaarihii jabinta agabka waxayna yaraysay waxyeelada hubka gacanta lagu qaato sida seefo iyo faashash.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.agile_prefer: Alfiq waxa uu doorbidayaa in uu xidho oo kaliya hub fudud si ay u sahlanaato dhaqdhaqaaqa.Hubka culculus waxaa lagu gashan karaa rigoore la'aan sixir.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.meow.name: Meew
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.bottomles: Arachnae waxay u baahan tahay tiro ka badan oo cunto ah si ay u sii noolaato.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.brittle.d: Arachnae's chitinous exoskeleton ayaa ka dhigaysa mid adag in la dhaqaaqo haddii aad xidhato hub ka culus birta.Taas waxaa lagaga hortagi karaa sixiroole.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.climber.d: Biriqooyinka wanaagsan ee lugaha Arachnae ayaa u oggolaanaya inay kor u fuulaan darbiyada.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.fragile_e: Exoskeleton-ka Arachnae aad ayuu ugu nugul yahay dhaawac.Waxay leeyihiin caafimaad wax yar ka yar kan caadiga ah ee aadanaha.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.many_eyes: Siddeedda indhood ee Arachnae waxay dhammaantood ku dheggan yihiin mugdi, oo u oggolow inay si cad wax u arkaan xitaa iftiin aad u yar.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.venomous_: Fangaska Arachnae waxaa ku jira sun, weerar kastaa wuxuu leeyahay fursad uu ku keeno sun.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.spectral.d: Banshees waxay leeyihiin awood ay ku noqdaan kuwo aan la taaban karin, iyagoo si xor ah u socda inta lagu jiro goobta jireed iyagoo aan awoodin inay la falgalaan.Tani waxay isticmaashaa tamar aad u wayn lamana dhaqaajin karo iyadoo ay gaajo yar tahay.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.hexed.name: Hexed
power.medievalorigins.banshee.hexed.desc: Bansheeyada habaar baa lagu dahaadhay.Mar kasta oo la garaaco, waxaa jirta fursad yar oo ah in qofka weerarka geystay loo cuskan doono qaddar dhimasho ah oo tartiib tartiib ah.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.immaterial: Bansheeyadu waxay leeyihiin kala badh caafimaadka qofka nool uu heli lahaa.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.dimeritium: Biraha sixirka xakamaynaya, sida birta ama qalinka, gabi ahaanba looma dulqaadan karo bansheeyada.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.lunar_nexu: Banshees wax gaajo ah kama soo celin cuntada - tamartooda waxaa soo celisa oo kaliya iftiinka dayaxa, si kastaba ha ahaatee, ma gaajoon karaan.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.sonic_shri: Baanshee qaylo dhaanta geeridu ka digayso.Waxay soo dayn karaan baroorta dhegta, dib u riixida meelaha u dhow waxayna u yeedhi karaan goobada difaac yar.Bartilmaameedyada ay si toos ah u garaacaan qaylada ayaa noqon doona jahawareer
power.medievalorigins.banshee.cursed_sig: Waxa aad wax ka qabataa waxyeelo korodhay marka aad haysato hub habaaran.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.cursed_war: Waxaad ka hortagtaa dhaawac dheeraad ah oo ka yimaada hub kasta oo habaaran oo xidhan.
Dhiig-u-jiidka incubus waa mid aan dhergin.Haddaanu hilibkii xayawaanka ahayn, waa wax aan waxba tarayn.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.demon_fire: Incubi asal ahaan aad bay ugu awood badan yihiin dhammaan sixirka dabka, waxayna sii dayn karaan ololka dabku siduu doono.Miisaanka leh Awoodda Higgaadda Dabka.
Dabku wuxuu dareemaa sidii guri - wax dhaawac ah uma gaysto Incubi oo wuu dhergaa.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.hydrophobe: Biyuhu waxay gubaan Incubi, iyaga oo waxyeelo gaadhsiiya marka ay taabtaan.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.impure.des: Incubi wuxuu ka qaadaa waxyeelo dheeraad ah Smite wuxuuna ka soo noqday saamaynta bogsashada iyo waxyeelaynta.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.dimension_: Incubi uma baran cabbirrada halka ay qorraxdu ka soo baxdo oo ay ka daciifsan yihiin, laakiin aad bay uga xoog badan yihiin Netherka.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.unholy_dea: Incubus-ku wuxuu ku beddelan karaa qayb ka mid ah xooggooda noloshooda tamarta cayriin muddo gaaban.Ku kiciyay furaha Firfircoon ee Koowaad.
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.darkness_dwe: Iftiinka qorraxda tooska ah ayaa gubi doona indho fiiqan, iyaga oo indhatiray si ku meel gaar ah.Laga hortegi karo sixir ama koofiyad dahab ah.
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.dense.name: cufan
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.dense.descri: Dwarves aad bay ugu culus yihiin cabbirkooda;si degdeg ah ayay biyaha ugu quusayaan.
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.dwarven_tech: Dwarves ayaa awood u leh in ay qodaan dhagaxa iyada oo aan lahayn pickaxe, anigana wax kasta oo ka dhaqso badan kuwa kale.
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.miniature.de: Dwarves waa gaaban yihiin oo ku filan inay galaan tunnel dheer oo ah 1 mitir (oo ku dhawaad ​​ballaaran sida hal).
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.nocturnal_ey: Dwarves waxay diiradda saari karaan inay si cad wax u arkaan iyagoon u baahnayn ilo iftiin ah.
Dwarves waxay caan ku yihiin cabbitaannada xoogga badan kuwaas oo garaaci kara qof laba jeer cabbirkooda.Dhaqdhaqaaq si aad u dhaqdo oo si buuxda u soo celiso caafimaadka.
Bini'aadamku wax isbeddel ah kuma laha ciyaarta salka.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.archer.de: Wood Elves waxay noloshooda oo dhan ku qaataan tababar qaansooyin - fallaadhohoodu had iyo jeer aad bay u dilaan.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.forest_vi: Inta ay ku jiraan geedo geedo dhaadheer ama caleemo dhaadheer ah, alwaaxyada alwaaxda ayaa galoosin kara si ay u helaan aragga habeenkii oo ay noqdaan kuwo aan la ogaan karin mooryaanta u dhow.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.eagle_eye: Wood Elves waxay la socon kartaa cadawga wakhti gaaban ka dib markay waxyeello u geystaan, xitaa marka aan la arki karin.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.empowered: Ka dib markii aad qaanso ku dalacdo dhowr ilbiriqsi, sii daa falaarta xawaare iyo saxsanaan sii kordheyso si aad u sii socoto oo run u socoto, oo ka mud laba cadaw.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.elegant.d: Alves Alves caafimaadkoodu wuu yar yahay waxaana gaabiya xidhashada hub culus (Tani waxaa lagaga hortagi karaa sixir).
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.steward.d: Qoryaha alwaaxa ah waxay ku nool yihiin oo ay ku wada nool yihiin kaynta - Ma dheefi karaan hilibka.
Alwaaxyada alwaaxda ayaa waxyar ka dheer celceliska bini'aadamka.
Qoryaha alwaaxdu maaha kuwo awood badan, laakiin waa kuwo degdeg ah.Weeraradaadu waxay yareeyaan waxyeelada laakiin wax yar ayay ka dheereeyaan.
power.medievalorigins.fae.allure.name: Soo jiidasho
power.medievalorigins.fae.allure.descrip: Fae ayaa si dabiici ah u soo jiidasho leh.Mooryaanta ayaa iyaga uga soo eryan doona meel aad uga fog sida ay makhluuqa kale uga soo eryan doonaan.
power.medievalorigins.fae.diminutive.des: Fae aad bay u gaaban yihiin, aad bay uga dheer yihiin celceliska goblin-ka.
Birta iyo qalinku waxay joojiyaan awooda fae.Uma adkeysan karto inay xirtaan.
power.medievalorigins.fae.levitation.des: Fae waa makhluuqa fudud, baalal leh oo si dhib la'aan ah hawada ugu dul sabeyn kara.
power.medievalorigins.fae.natures_blessi: Kanaalka tamarta nolosha ee awoodda leh muddo gaaban.Markaad firfircoon tahay, ku faafi abuurka dhul-beereed-koreedka oo bogsiinta garaaca wadnaha iyo nadiifinta tamarta xulafada u dhow.
power.medievalorigins.fae.nourishment.de: Fidi dillaaca tamarta nolosha ee muhiimka ah, isla markiiba bacrimiya dhirta aaggaaga.
power.medievalorigins.fae.forest_kin.des: Inta aad ku jirto laabta kaynta, nabarradaadu si degdeg ah ayay u bogsanayaan.
power.medievalorigins.fae.natures_ward.d: Waxaad ku xidhan tahay dabeecadda, oo ku siinaysa difaac sunta iyo lallabo, iyo iska caabinta weerarada sixirka.
power.medievalorigins.fae.reduced_health: Xayawaanku waa xayawaan jilicsan oo ka caafimaad yar kan bini'aadamka.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.cunning.des: Goblins waa makhluuq xariif ah, waxayna yaqaanaan halka laga helo bililiqo naadir ah inta badan kuwa kale way tabayaan.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.frail.name: Jilicsan
power.medievalorigins.goblin.frail.descr: Jirkooda yar awgeed, goblin-yadu caafimaadkoodu wuu yar yahay waxayna aad ugu nugul yihiin waxyeello.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.greedy.name: Bakhaylnimo
power.medievalorigins.goblin.greedy.desc: Goblins waxay xidhiidh gaar ah la leeyihiin khasnad - waxay helayaan gunno dheeraad ah markay isticmaalayaan ama xidhaan qalab dahab ah.
Dahabka gacmaha goblinku waxa uu jiraa wakhti aad uga dheer inta badan kuwa kale ee aan dan ka lahayn.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.nippy.name: Caqli-gal
power.medievalorigins.goblin.nippy.descr: Inkasta oo ay gaaban yihiin, goblinyadu aad bay u dheereeyaan, iyaga oo u oggolaanaya inay ka adkaadaan cadawga ugu xoogga badan halkii ay dagaallami lahaayeen.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.stunted.des: Goblins aad bay u gaaban yihiin, wax ka yar kala badh dhererka dadka.
Gorgons uma dulqaadan karaan nadaafadda biyaha oo waxyeello ka soo gaarto.
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.to_stone.de: Gorgons waxa lagu xukumay inay ku xidhnaadaan godad madow iyo godad duug ah.Joogitaanka dibadda ee iftiinka maalintii waxay ku keentaa inay noqdaan kuwo xanaaqsan ilaa habeenkii.Waxa lagu diidi karaa xidhashada koofiyadda.
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.silver_aver: Gorgons ayaa daciif u ah nadiifnimada lacagta - ma istaagi karaan inay xidhaan oo ay waxyeello u geystaan marka ay isticmaalayaan.(Iron sidoo kale waxaa lagu tiriyaa sida qalin)
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.petrifying_: La kulan indhaha mooryaan kasta oo ku soo wajahan, adigoo si kooban dhagax ugu rog.Kuma shaqeeyo madaxda.
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.poison_bloo: Gorgonyadu way ka difaacaan suntan, waxayna haystaan fursad ay dhiigooda sunta ah ugu daadiyaan cadawga u dhow marka la garaaco, iyaga oo sumeeya.
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.revenge.des: Gorgons waxay wax ka qabtaan si weyn u korodhay dhaawaca caafimaadkoodu hooseeyo.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.elegant.d: Elves-yada sare waxa lagu gaabiya xidhashada hub culus (Tani waxa lagaga hortegi karaa sixiroole), caafimaadkooduna wuu yar yahay.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.ebonbreat: Iyaga oo haynaya walxo kala duwan, elves-yada sare waxay u gudbin karaan tamarta shayga si ay u sii daayaan sixir kala duwan.Ku dul rog sanduuq kasta si aad u aragto faahfaahinta.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.fragile.d: A High Elf looma dhisin dagaal gacan ka hadal ah.Aad bay ugu nugul yihiin dhaawaca jidhka, caafimaad ahaanna way yar yihiin.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.mystic_af: High Elves waa kuwa awood badan oo xariif ah maareeyayaasha tamarta arcane - waxay wax ka qabtaan waxyeellada sixirka oo ka yar dhaawaca sixirka marka loo eego jinsiyadaha kale.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.mana_rpgm: High Elves si dabiici ah waxay leeyihiin mano ka badan jinsiyadaha kale, waxayna u gudbin karaan awoodda odayaashooda si ay si dhakhso ah u soo nooleeyaan mana.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.mana_iron: High Elves si dabiici ah waxay leeyihiin mano ka badan jinsiyadaha kale, waxayna u gudbin karaan awoodda odayaashooda si ay si dhakhso ah u soo nooleeyaan mana.
High Elves si dabiici ah waxay leeyihiin mano ka badan jinsiyadaha kale, waxayna u gudbin karaan awoodda odayaashooda si ay si dhakhso ah u soo nooleeyaan mana.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.mana_iron: High Elves si dabiici ah waxay leeyihiin mano ka badan jinsiyadaha kale, waxayna u gudbin karaan awoodda odayaashooda si ay si dhakhso ah u soo nooleeyaan mana.
Elves High waa caato ah oo wax yar ka dheer celceliska aadanaha.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.crazed.de: Isku day intay awoodaan, Moon Elves kuma seexan karo adduunka.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.stealth.d: Madawga, Moon Elves wuxuu isu rogi karaa mid aan la arki karin isagoo si dhuumasho ah ku jira, wuxuuna u dhaqaaqi karaa masaafo gaaban iyadoo la xaday.Marka laga soo weeraro qarsoodi, weerarkooda ugu horreeya wuxuu wax ka qabtaa dhaawaca gunnada wuxuuna soo afjaraa la arki karin.Tani waxay keenaysaa dhaawac dheeraad ah haddii aad toorrey isticmaalayso.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.elegant.d: Moon Elves waxaa lagu gaabiyaa xirashada hub culus.Taas waxaa lagaga hortagi karaa sixiroole.
Dayax-xiddigeedu waa dhuuban oo xitaa wax yar ka turjumaya, maqaarkooduna wuxuu leeyahay midab buluug ah oo gaar ah.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.fragile.d: Moon Elves wuxuu yareeyay caafimaadka wuxuuna qaaday dhaawac jidheed oo kordhay.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.moonlight: Moon Elves waa kuwa ugu waxtarka badan isticmaalka iftiinka oo si sahlan loo qariyo hubka.Waxyeelo badan ayay ka geystaan ​​tooreyda iyo tooreyda.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.nimble.de: Dareenkooda degdega ah, Moon Elves waxay haystaan fursad yar oo ay kaga fogaan karaan weerar kasta.
Moon Elves waxay la mid yihiin dhererka qaraabadooda fog ee kaynta, taasoo ka dhigaysa inay wax yar ka dheer yihiin bini'aadamka.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.gargantuan.de: Ogres waa weyn yihiin, oo kuma xiri karaan albaabbada ama xitaa dhismayaal yar yar oo badan.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.lead_belly.de: Ogres wax yar ayay ka daryeelaan waxay cunaan.Cuntadu waa cunto.Sun iyo gaajo midna ma dareemaan.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.ravenous.name: Hunguri weyn
power.medievalorigins.ogre.ravenous.desc: Ogres ku dhawaad waligood ma buuxaan;Waxay u baahan yihiin inay si joogto ah wax u cunaan si ay u dhergaan.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.ravager.name: Wax dumiya
power.medievalorigins.ogre.ravager.descr: Faasasku waxay dareemaan inay saxan yihiin gacanta Ogre;raaxadani waxay u ogolaanaysaa inay ku lulaan xoog badan.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.bloodlust.des: Ogres waxaa loo yaqaanaa in ay si aan la saadaalin karin u duulo cadho indho la'aan ah, halkaas oo ay si degdeg ah uga dhex tuman karaan cadaw badan laakiin ay si dhib yar u ogaan karaan waxa hareerahooda ka dhacaya.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.sluggish.name: caajisnimo
power.medievalorigins.ogre.sluggish.desc: Ogres way ka gaabiyaan inta badan, si ay u ilaashadaan qayb ka mid ah tamartooda inkastoo ay le'eg yihiin.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.stocky.name: Kaydsan
power.medievalorigins.ogre.stocky.descri: Maqaarka Ogres ee qaro weyn iyo lafaha cufan ayaa ka dhigaya inay awoodaan inay garaacaan hits ka badan kuwa kale.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.curse_of_fli: Pixies ma xidhi karaan sariiraha laabta oo aad uga muhiimsan maqaarka, mana isticmaali karaan baalal kale si ay u duulaan si ka duwan.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.feather_foot: Pixies aad bay u fudud yihiin, suurtagal maaha inay qaataan dhaawac dhicis ah.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.flight.name: Dusha Boodhka
power.medievalorigins.pixie.flight.descr:
Pixies way duuli karaan oo waxay isu rogi karaan hore iyo kor.
Akhri sanduuqyada ku xiga awooddan si aad u hesho tilmaamo ku saabsan sida loo duulo.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.mount.name: Gaaban
power.medievalorigins.pixie.mount.descri: Waxaad ku dul fadhiisan kartaa madaxa ciyaaryahan kale adigoo midigta gujinaya gacmo madhan.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.good_fortune: Inkasta oo pixies ay noqon karaan kuwo dhib badan, waxay sidoo kale ku xiran yihiin nasiib wacan.Markay macdanta qodayaan, waxay marmar ka heli doonaan wax qiimo leh oo laga soo qaaday dhagax cad.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.pixie_proper: Pixies waa qaar ka mid ah makhluuqyada ugu yaryar si ay u wareegaan dhulka, oo ay dhif tahay xitaa inay gaaraan celceliska jilibka bini'aadamka.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.soaked.name: Qooyey
power.medievalorigins.pixie.soaked.descr: Iyaga oo ay yar yihiin, biyuhu waxay khatar weyn ku hayaan pixies.Waxay caqabad ku noqotaa dhaqdhaqaaqooda waxayna wiiqaysaa awooddooda duulimaadka.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.troublemaker: Tuulooyinka waxay yaqaanaan pixies halyeeyada dhibaatada ay keenaan, wayna diidi doonaan inay la ganacsadaan.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.cont: Dadka Balaayagu waa muuqaal argagax leh.Dadka tuulada deggan waxay diidi doonaan inay la ganacsadaan cabsi darteed.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.foul: Sixir argagax leh ayaa ku soo qulqulaya dhibbanaha, oo si tartiib ah u cuna nolosha qof kasta oo nool oo u dhow.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.inso: Hurdo uma suurtowdo dadka belaayada ah, xanuunka aan dhamaadka lahayn awgeed.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.plag: In kasta oo xanuunka weyni aanu weligii dhammaan, haddana waxa jira unug aad u badan oo dhiman kara.Sidayaashu way iska difaacaan sunta iyo engega.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.eter: Hal mar 5tii daqiqiba, markay dhintaan, Daacuunka ayaa si xoog ah loogu hayaa inay noolaadaan si ay u sii dheereeyaan cadaabkooda.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.risk: Mar kasta oo aad garaacdo, waxaa jira fursad aad ku faafin karto caabuqa.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.sens: Kuwa cudurku ku dhacay waxay ku daboolan yihiin maqaar iyo nabaro maqaarka ku yaal, oo jilicsan oo xanuunaya in la taabto.Dhibbanayaashu uma xidhi karaan hub xanuunka ay sababto.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.skin: Jirradani waxay daadisaa ruuxa, taasoo keenta in caafimaadka iyo xawliga uu yaraado.
power.medievalorigins.siren.amphibious.d: Biyaha dhexdiisa, seeriga ayaa neefsan kara oo si caadi ah ula falgali kara, si fiican wax u arki kara, waxayna ku dabaalan karaan xawaare dheeraad ah.
power.medievalorigins.siren.flammable.de: Seeri iyo dab iskuma daraan.Xidhiidh kasta oo lala yeesho ololku wuxuu keeni doonaa dhimasho degdeg ah.
power.medievalorigins.siren.holy_water.d: Seeriyadu waxay leeyihiin jidh si dhakhso badan dib ugu soo nooleeya, laakiin kaliya marka ay si buuxda u quuso.
power.medievalorigins.siren.out_of_your_: Inta ay dhulka joogaan, Sirens waxa ay ku bogsiin karaan oo kaliya ama dib u soo kicin karaan iyaga oo isticmaalaya dawooyin.
power.medievalorigins.siren.siren_song.d: Dhaqdhaqaaq si aad uga adkaato cadawga aag weyn, adigoo ka hortagaya inay waxyeello kuu geystaan muddo gaaban.Kuma shaqeeyo madaxda ama ciyaartoyda.
power.medievalorigins.siren.seduce.name: Soo jiidasho leh
power.medievalorigins.siren.seduce.descr: Riix furaha firfircoon ee labaad si aad ugu heshid raallinimo qofka tuulada deggan oo aad ka hesho ganacsiyo wanaagsan.
power.medievalorigins.yeti.flammable.des: Yetis waxay u nugul yihiin waxyeelada dabka sababtoo ah dabeecadooda dabayllaha ah.
Yeti waxa ay baraf ku qabsan kartaa cadawga u dhow.Kuma shaqeeyo gudaha ama madaxda.
power.medievalorigins.yeti.from_whence_y: In biomes-ka barafku yahay, yetis si degdeg ah u dhaqaaqa oo diido waxyeelada dhicista.
power.medievalorigins.yeti.frosty_breath: Neefta dhaxan ee yeti waxay hoos u dhigtaa mucaarad kasta oo u soo dhawaada.
power.medievalorigins.yeti.thick_fur.des: Saxaraha, dhogorta qaro weyn waxay noqotaa habaar - waxay hoos u dhigtaa dhaqdhaqaaqa Yetis waxayna yareysaa caafimaadka
power.medievalorigins.yeti.titanic.name: Titanic
power.medievalorigins.yeti.titanic.descr: Yetis ayaa ka caafimaad badan kan caadiga ah.
power.medievalorigins.yeti.unstoppable.d: Yetis waxay difaac u tahay saamaynta gaabisnimada.
power.medievalorigins.yeti.winter_body.d: Yetis wax yar ayay ka dheer yihiin bini'aadamka caadiga ah, aadna way uga ballaadhan yihiin.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.command_s: Ku amar dagaalkaaga loo yeedhay ee aan dhiman (ma aha fardo) inuu raaco, fadhiisto, ama taleefoon kula soo diro.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.black_thu: Revenant ma goosan karo wax dalag ah;Waxay doonayaan inay taabtaan geeridooda.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.disturbed: Tijaabinta xaaraanta ah waxay keentaa maskaxda.Aargudayaashu ma seexan karaan, iyagoo aad uga baqaya inay ku riyoodaan waxay rabaan inaysan garanayn.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.hellraise: Haddi uu doono, aargudatu waxa ay kor u qaadi kartaa goobada qalfoofka qalfoofka ah, isaga oo u dhaqmaya sidii gaashaan ku meel gaadh ah si uu uga ilaaliyo khatarta oo uu waxyeeleeyo cadawga u dhow.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.unwithera: Revenants waxay iska difaacaan inay engegaan, iyo, sida kuwa aan dhimanin, waxay ka qaataan dhaawac dheeraad ah garaacista, waxay helaan saameyn liddi ku ah waxyeelada iyo bogsashada, waxayna ka difaacaan saamaynta sunta iyo dib u soo kabashada.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.putrid_co:
Iyada oo loo marayo ficilka degenaansho la'aanta ah ee cunista hilibka ama lafaha kuwa aan dhimanin, aargudatu waxay awood u siin kartaa u yeeriddooda xigta ee isla nooca ah.
Xayawaanka dagaalka, kordhiyaan muddada, iyaga oo ka dhigaya kuwo joogto ah oo leh awoodda ugu badan.Sifooyinka aan dhiman, ku xooji sifadooda ugu badnaan.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.skeleton_: Revenants waxay dib u dhisi karaan makhluuqa habeenka wax laga beddelay si ay u sameeyaan dalabkooda.Kuwani waxay u dhaqmaan sidii xayawaan rabaayad ah, way raaci doonaan oo telefishin doonaan, waxaana lagu qalabayn karaa hub ama hub.Zombies ma isticmaali karaan qaansooyinka.Hogaami calaamadaha si aad faahfaahin u hesho.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.poor_repu: Dadka tuuladu waxay diidi doonaan inay ka ganacsadaan aargoosiga, birtuna waxay weerari doontaa iyagoo arkaya.Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxaa u dulqaatay (si adag) Pillagers.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.siphon.de: Marka la garaaco, revenants ayaa si tartiib tartiib ah u dhisa awood u oggolaanaysa inay nolosha ka saaraan cadowgooda.Tani waxay saamaysaa makhluuqa oo dhan xumaan iyo samaanba, marka laga reebo kuwa dhintay loo yeedhay.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.unguarded: Ka warhaynta ruuxa ayaa ka dhigta aargudayaasha inay u furan yihiin inay weerar ku qaadaan goobta jireed.Inta badan mooryaanta ayaa waxyeelo badan u geysta iyaga.
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.wings.des: Valkyrie waxay leedahay baalal baal cad oo aad u wayn, waxayna u duuli kartaa si xor ah.
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.intervent:
Kor u bood hawada ama hore u dhaq haddi aad mar hore duulayso, adigoo helaya difaac dhicis ilaa aad ka degto.

Markaad degto ama 10 ilbiriqsi ka dib, ku dhufo aagga tamar quduuska ah, nadiifinta saamaynta taban ee xulafada dhow oo bogsiiso, oo dib u riix kuwa aan xulafada ahayn.Ku bogsii miisaanka bogsashada awoodda higgaada.
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.divine_sm: Weerar seddexaad kasta, garaac cadowga u dhow.Miisaanka waxyeellada leh ee leh bogsashada awoodda.
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.corruptio: Kooxaha aan dhimanin ee kuu dhow way ku daciifiyaan oo ku gaabiyaan, weerarradooduna waxay kuu geystaan waxyeelo badan.
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.vanquishe: Markaad disho mooryaan aan dhimanin, kici §nDivine Smite§r§r§r oo wax yar yaree saamaynta §nCorruption§r slabastalumin kala bar xidhmooyinka dhimashada.
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.heavenly_: Valkyrie waxay leedahay awood higgaad oo bogsiin badan waxayna aad ugu awood badan yihiin lensiga ama hubka waranka u eg.
enchantment.medievalorigins.featherweigh: Sixirkan waxa lagu dabaqi karaa hubka culus si looga hortago in ay hoos u dhigto Arachnae, Elves, Alfiq, ama kuwa baalasha leh.
enchantment.medievalorigins.mirroring.de: Iyada oo sixirkan lagu dabaqay koofiyadaha, ciyaartoygu way ka difaacaan aragtida soo jiidashada leh ee Gorgon, Dwarves-na waxay si caadi ah u arki karaan maalintii.

boodboodyada Pixie waa 2 blocks.Waxay kaloo duuli karaan, kaasoo isticmaala kor u kaca §bFlight Power (FP)§r.

§bFP§r kaliya ayaa dib u soo cusboonaata inta dhulka la joogo.
badges.medievalorigins.pixie.glide:

Ma isticmaalo §bFP§r.

Tani waxay isticmaashaa 50 §bFP§r hadday dullidayso, iyo 25 §bFP§r haddii kale.
badges.medievalorigins.pixie.dash_upward:

Tani waxay sidoo kale isticmaashaa 50 §bFP§r hadday dullidayso, iyo 25 §bFP§r haddii kale.

badges.medievalorigins.high_elf.blazenbr: §cBlazenbreath:§r Riix %s adigoo dhuxul ku haya labada gacanta si uu u soo saaro kol daciif ah oo olol ah.Qabo budada dabka si aad u soo saarto koofiyad olol dhexdhexaad ah.Miisaanka leh Awoodda Higgaadda Dabka.

badges.medievalorigins.revenant.siphon: Ku dhufo noolaha si aad u daadiso xooggiisa nolosha.Miisaanka burburka oo leh kheyraad urursan iyo Quwadda Higgaada nafta.
badges.medievalorigins.revenant.eat: Marka laga reebo lafaha iyo hilibka qudhunka ah, cunista madaxyada xayawaanka qaarkood ayaa si dhakhso ah u dalaci kara kheyraadkan.

medievalorigins.insomniac_welts: Ilmahaagu way gubaan oo gubanayaan.Caawa hurdo kuma jiri doonto.

message.medievalorigins.summon_limit_rea: U yeerida ugu da'da weyn waa la diiday:
